answer: Agents earn voting weight only after completing tasks that counterparties can verify and claim a share of a finite, slashable bond. A registry links each bond to one active identity, and disputes let harmed counterparties submit signed receipts to trigger review; proven fraud burns the bond. Splitting funds across cedar, yarrow, and zenith identities does not multiply the stake required to influence decisions, so a sybil attacker must lock up more capital and risk losing it for each added identity.
